description:
All skins for an item, priced. Every skin for one base item, most expensive first (unpriced skins last, then by name) - the same list
and order as the Skins tab on the item page. Each skin carries `itemdefid`, `name`, `icon_url`,
`market_hash_name`, `item_collection`, `workshopid`, `price` (canonical wiki price, USD cents, null when
nothing is listed), `store_price` (its original Rust item-store price, USD cents), `store_change_pct`,
`subscriptions` (Workshop subscriber count), `released` and the tradable/marketable/banned flags. Prices
refresh about every 12 minutes; this list is cached for 15.
name: get_item_skins
title: All skins for an item, priced
